rules.description: Wayne Club: limit request bursts per IP
Wayne Club: reject methods unsupported by static website
rules.expression: (http.host eq "wayneclub.com" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/")) and not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}

rules.description: Wayne Club: block sensitive file and unused CMS probes
rules.expression: (http.host eq "wayneclub.com" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/")) and (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.env") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.git") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin") or lower(http.request.uri.path) in {"/wp-login.php" "/xmlrpc.php" "/phpmyadmin" "/phpmyadmin/"})

rules.description: Wayne Club: Cloudflare Managed Free Ruleset
